extracted.name: Gluten-free salmon pasta
extracted.description: Use gluten-free pasta to make this creamy salmon and green bean pasta from GF reader Aimee Vivian. It's ideal for coeliacs or those intolerant to gluten.
ingredient_lines: 200g gluten-free pasta such as penne or fusilli
instruction_lines: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil, crumble in the stock cube and stir to dissolve. Tip in the pasta and cook following pack instructions, about 8-10 mins. Add the green beans 1 min before the end of the cooking time.

Drain the pasta and green beans, reserving a little of the cooking water. Tip the pasta and beans back into the pan, then stir in the smoked salmon, spinach, spring onion and soft cheese. Add a little of the pasta water to loosen the cheese and create a sauce, then season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Squeeze in the lemon juice to taste, and stir well. Serve topped with the parmesan.
